entities.summary: Christopher, a notable figure in the history of Saint Kitts and Nevis, associated with European Contact and the Mother Colony of the West Indies (1493–1623). Preceded by Columbus's Sighting and Early Exploration. Their legacy influenced Thomas Warner founds first English Caribbean colony on Saint Kitts and Thomas Warner.
